text: Are you an expatriate wondering if you can buy property in Saudi Arabia? Here's a quick guide from Alnowaiser Law Firm. Foreign residents with a valid Iqama may purchase residential property for personal use in designated residential areas outside Makkah and Madinah. Licensed foreign companies may also own commercial real estate necessary for their operations. The process involves verifying eligibility, conducting title due diligence through the Ministry of Justice, and paying a five percent Real Estate Transaction Tax. Additionally, the Premium Residency program offers expanded ownership rights for qualifying individuals. If you're planning to buy property in Saudi Arabia, our team can help. Speak with Alnowaiser Law Firm.
